entries.text: His build order is strict: clean and clarify all dialogue first, shape the music around it, then add effects, then rebalance once everything is up. Layering lets him judge each component's place.

source.title: Andy Nelson: 2014 CAS Career Achievement Award

entries.text: Nelson begins the surrounds sparse and only adds what the screen asks for, rather than filling the room by default and then trying to thin it out.
